fact: The World Bank's assessment of 12 February 2025 states that Nigeria's national EMIS team has a minimal budget and can only issue guidance to states, which must finance data collection from limited resources, and that the HOPE-EDU programme (IDA and GPE contribution US$552.18 million) will strengthen the EMIS in all states and the FCT so that the digital Annual School Census form maintained by NEMIS is adopted everywhere; the EMIS it describes is the census.
title: Nigeria HOPE for Quality Basic Education for All (HOPE-EDU) Program-for-Results: Environment and Social Systems Assessment (ESSA)
